## Description
Provide a concise explanation of changes made and the motivation behind them.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that causes existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Performance optimization / Refactoring
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the project's code style and guidelines.
- [ ] I have self-reviewed my own code.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix or feature works as intended.
- [ ] All new and existing unit tests pass locally (`pytest`).
- [ ] Frontend builds cleanly without TypeScript/Vite errors (`npm run build`).
- [ ] No API keys, secrets, or sensitive tokens are committed.
- [ ] Documentation has been updated accordingly.
